before.title: Richard Grove, Editorial, Environment and History 1(1) (1995), 1–2
before.note: Complete two-page founding editorial read. Describes planning with Ramachandra Guha, connections to history from below and material culture, and a geographically broad programme complementing existing North American venues. An incidental erroneous Silent Spring date is not used.

after.title: Richard Grove, Editorial, Environment and History 1(1) (1995), 1–2
after.note: Complete two-page founding editorial read. Describes planning with Ranajit Guha, connections to history from below and material culture, and a geographically broad programme complementing existing North American venues. An incidental erroneous Silent Spring date is not used.

source_corrections.reason: Correct the person named in Grove’s editorial: Ranajit Guha, not Ramachandra Guha. Retain the source for the rejected founding claim’s audit trail.
